url.description: URL of the input audio file. Provide either url or audio — exactly one is required, not both.

audio.description: The audio file to transcribe. Provide either url or audio — exactly one is required, not both. Up to 20 MB.

language_codes.description: BCP-47 codes of the languages spoken in the audio, for example ["he-IL"] or ["en-US", "es-ES"]. Omit them to detect the language automatically (85+ languages, mixed-language speech included).

custom_vocabulary.description: Up to 1,000 names, acronyms or terms to bias recognition toward (best results with up to 100). Cannot be combined with diarization or word_timestamps.

diarization.description: Split the transcript into speaker turns labelled spk_1, spk_2, … (up to 8 speakers; 3 or more is experimental). Audio is then limited to 30 minutes.

word_timestamps.description: Return start and end times for every word. May lower accuracy; audio is then limited to 30 minutes.

mode.description: "verbatim" (the default) keeps every spoken word, fillers included. "smart" removes fillers and false starts, applies self-corrections and formats lists, numbers and dates; it cannot be combined with diarization or word_timestamps.
